content: Kabebay sagal veivay
Vayuwein Yeisuw ikabebay liva̱nen Yowbad nakaleiwag. Ilana, “Yowbad nakaleiwag ma̱wana guyaw teitan inasagal. Bo isagal peinan natun teitan beivay.
“Inasagal avanin ikatineg ikous, ikayabes natouwat mwasanin, idawes gamag bimeis bisagals. Ipiyaves gog.

“Wankuyeim ikayabes natouwat mwasanin, idawes tasiyas ilansa, ‘Datoveks bo ikatineg kan ikous, bulumakaw kawka̱veks bo iweiys ikous, bulumakaw bulwaway, askeitub igegayous, bo iweiys ikous, youd babaw bo ikatinages ikous. Kumeis sagal towen, peinan tamwey natun bo beivay.’

“Tasiyas gog ipiyaves, issebaws, inounas ineis palatan palatan, teitan in wa̱bag, teitan in bigimwal, mwasanin gog nisesus waven iyousis tamwey natouwats iyagages. Natouwat tasiyas asimwasin nag bikakit va̱gan; mwasanin ge iweiys ikatimates.
“Guyaw towen iligen, kapasal nuwan, ikayabes takanaviys, ineis iweiys takalbalebs tasiyas ikous, sibunatum babaw igabus kov waseg.
“Iyums takanaviys; iwa̱ge tamwey ilana, ‘Na-ikadilokes tasiyas beikams sagal to nakatineg. Kuneis guntouwat yakamiy, kudawes tasiyas wadadan ked nisesus, kukin kalisiy bukuba̱nes, kudawes bimeis.’
“Inounas palatan palatan, tababaw iba̱nes mo idawes, mwasanin takalba̱lebs, mwasanin toubweins. Iliganes, ikatuyouns imeis, bo ika̱lawt gamag babaw wasagal.
“Tamwey towen im bikin gamag babaw-wan, iban teitan ta-isikam sagal kweiman, idibek, ilana, ‘Gwa, ama̱wan nukum, ta-ivag amkweim sagal kweiman?’ Towen isesuna ikika̱pay.
“Iw to guyaw, idibakes natouwats ilana, ‘Kuywanis naman kaken taw towen, kulaves bein watoulan, dadub waseg.’ Tasiyas watoulan bivva̱lams-wan, singaya bigeg ninous.
“Yowbad bo idawes gamag babaw; teyuy-e beisiws bimeis.”
Sisal nata̱kis
Siyas Palisiy iliganes, mo ineis, illivans sisiyas, idokes bikatiga̱nes kid mo beibol Yeisuw anilivan.

Illivans ee... sinap kweitan mo iton. Ikous mo ikayabes sivamul mwasanin sisiyas Elod nagamag mwasanin, idibakes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Tamwey yak, kakakin amsinap mounid, kakakin Yowbad nakaleiwag kukwatimlakay mounid, o nag kugoulus guyawaw mwasanin, peinan gamag babaw wamatam bo katanok-wan. Wananoum ama̱wan? kadilokeids bitatams Sisal nata̱kis? o nag? bitapiyaves adok?”
Yeisuw gog ikakina asisinap kalbaleb, ilana, “Aveiyag wawun kuyakwaneigs? Tayyaweids yakamiy! Kwatimlakeigs money towen, ta̱kis silma̱nin.” Money katanok mo isekes.
Ikow money towen wanaman, ikatimlakes king yagan nises son kululuwan nilel money towen waseg, ikatugan, ilana, “Kavel yagan? kavel kululuwan towen?”
Ilansa, “Sisal.” Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Sisal navavag bweina kutams Sisal waseg, o Yowbad navavag bweina kutams Yowbad waseg.”
Iliganes, isom ninous, iyums ineis wasiven.
Gamag beikits vayuwein

Yam towen tasiyas Sadusiy mo inekes Yeisuw. Tasiyas Sadusiy asilivan ilansa, “Gamag nag beikits kanig waseg.” Mapun ikatiga̱nes Yeisuw ilansa, “Tamwey, Moses nakaleiwag mamagina, kukin kal bikanig, nakwav sam, tage natun nag, kadiloka bwadan beivays son nakwab, igaw mo bikop natun bimlavag tuwan natun.
“E, kunutaw teitan wamaven nises, budan teinim tatanok. Kunutaw ivays son nakwav, natun nag, ikanig, isikein ivays son nakwab.
“E, isikein ikanig, natun nag, nakwab ivays son tawa̱nay. Tasiyas tawa̱nay imta̱mats ikous, nitsiyas nag, oko digumasus mo ivays son nakwab; ikanig, natun nag.
“Ikous tawaw babaw, wankuyeim mo ikanig kuda̱vin mana̱wen.
“Igaw tutan beikits kanig waseg, vin mana̱wen namwan amtowen? Peinan asibabaw neivays siney.”

Yeisuw gog ikatimop asilivan, ilana, “Ibol ninoumiy, peinan nag kukwakins Bukitab, o peinan nag kukwakins Yowbad natawtoun. Igaw tut wanakougwaw gamag beikits kanig waseg, mo beikous veivay, peinan gamag bimlavags mamagina Yowbad nataka̱yob nisesus walba̱lab.
“E, mounid gamag beikits kanig waseg. Adok nag bukuvinis Yowbad anilivan wasigeis yakamiy, peinan ilana:
Yowbad nag ikaleiwag takanigs tatuwes wasigeis; nag. Tage tamwamovs wasigeis ikaleiwag.”
Gamag babaw iliganes ansinap, bo isom ninous waseg.
Kaleiwag towen imug

Tasiyas Palisiy iliganes Yeisuw nikatimop asilivan Sadusiy, nika̱pays, mo ikatuyouns tasiyas Palisiy, imeis. Palisiy teitan ikatigan Yeisuw, mtowen ya̱tal sinapun ikakin; ikatugan va̱gan kid biyakwen Yeisuw, ilana, “Dakaleiwags waseg, aw-kaleiwag imug?”
Iw to Yeisuw ilana,

content.text: “‘Kadiloka kusiwa̱youb daGuyaws Yowbad, kululuwam waseg, kaleivim waseg, o nanoum waseg.’

content: Kaleiwag towen imug; imgwayes kaleiwag babaw wasigeis.
“Kaleiwag tawtoun kwayuwein nises:
“Akweiyuna kaleiwag tasiyas wawun kaleiwag babaw, o wawun siyas palopit asilivan babaw.”
Deibid tabun
Tasiyas Palisiy ikatuyouns nimeis, Yeisuw mo ikatiga̱nes, ilana, “Waninoumiy Mesay ama̱wan? kavel tabun?” Iweis tasiyas, ilansa, “Deibid tabun.”
Yeisuw mo ikatiga̱nes, ilana, “E, Mesay Deibid tabun; tage kweiboug Yowbad Kululuwan isek Deibid ansinap mo ilivan, idok Mesay inaguyaw tatonen; anilivan mamagina:

content.text: Kusin wagunka̱tay, va̱gan bava̱ges beibus siyas astameiliw yak, bukuvnivans wakunutes.’

content: Peinan Mesay Deibid tabun, ama̱wan Deibid idok tabun naGuyaw tatonen?”
Bo ika̱pays tasiyas. Ta-kal bikatimop aygan. Bo iyakous sikatugan waseg Yeisuw. Wankuyeim mo igoulus; nag teitan ikatugan waseg, nag.
